response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, desktop and some embedded work, strong testing/craftsmanship practices, and relevant distributed low-latency experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic). However, the role is fundamentally a C++ engineering position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments (2014-2015) and a university thesis project — over a decade ago. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, message brokers/MQTT, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle work, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Azure. His core stack (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Ember/React) does not map onto the primary technical requirements, and the mentoring-on-security-standards expectation would be a stretch. A strong generalist, but a poor match for this specific mandate.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) with strong TDD/CI/CD and craftsmanship culture
Proven high-performance, concurrent, event-driven systems work (async I/O, fibers, microservices at scale)
Demonstrated mentoring, workshops and technical communication (talks, courses, dojos)
concerns: Minimal and dated C++/STL experience; no modern C++ evidence in the last 10 years
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, MQTT, or fieldbus protocol background
Profile is web/full-stack-centric (TS/Node/D), not systems-level platform engineering as required

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial cybersecurity / IEC 62443 and IoT protocol experience
